reason_text: Procedure deemed elective and not medically necessary based on clinical guidelines
Conservative or non-surgical treatment options have not been exhausted prior to surgical intervention
Treatment classified as experimental, investigational, or unproven under current medical standards
Procedure classified as cosmetic in nature without documented functional impairment
Number of treatments exceeds medically accepted frequency for the diagnosed condition
Less invasive or less costly alternative treatment is available and appropriate
Clinical records do not sufficiently demonstrate medical necessity for the requested procedure
Requested procedure is not appropriate for the patient's age, condition, or prognosis
Condition can be adequately managed in outpatient or daycare setting; inpatient admission not warranted
Diagnostic investigation ordered without clinical indication or prior abnormal result
Condition classified as pre-existing disease as per policy definition; treatment within specified waiting period
Listed specific disease/condition claimed within the initial 24-month waiting period
Pre-existing condition disclosed or discovered; claim within 48-month (4-year) waiting period
Claim filed during the initial 30-day cooling-off/waiting period after policy inception
Policyholder failed to disclose pre-existing medical condition in proposal form; policy voidable under Section 45
Claim denied despite 8-year moratorium period completion; insurer incorrectly invoking pre-existence
Break in continuous policy renewal reset the waiting period for pre-existing conditions
Waiting period credit not granted during insurer-to-insurer portability
Specific surgical procedure excluded during the first policy year
Condition deemed congenital and excluded under lifetime waiting clause
Condition permanently excluded under policy terms (e.g., self-inflicted injury, substance abuse, STDs)
Injury arising from war, nuclear event, or participating in hazardous activity excluded under general exclusions
Routine dental treatment or procedure not arising from accident excluded under policy terms
IVF, fertility treatment, and related procedures excluded under standard health policy
Maternity expenses excluded unless specific maternity rider/add-on was purchased
Bariatric/weight-loss surgery excluded unless BMI exceeds threshold and comorbidities documented
Alternative medicine (Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy) not covered under base plan
Corrective eye surgery for refractive errors (LASIK, PRK) excluded under policy terms
Treatment not recognized by established medical bodies or not evidence-based
Injury sustained during participation in extreme sports, racing, or hazardous recreation
Total admissible claim amount exceeds the remaining sum insured for the policy year
Specific expense category exceeds the applicable sub-limit (room rent, ICU, ambulance)
Room charges exceed the per-day limit; proportionate deduction applied to all medical expenses
Claim amount is below the mandatory deductible/excess threshold
Mandatory co-payment percentage deducted from the admissible claim amount
Non-medical expenses (NME) deducted as per IRDAI guidelines Annexure IV
Charges exceed reasonable and customary rates for the geographic area and facility type
Treatment covered under network hospital package rate; excess charges non-reimbursable
No-claim bonus/cumulative bonus not applicable due to prior year claim utilization
Aggregate deductible for super top-up policy not met by prior base policy utilization
Final discharge summary from treating hospital not submitted with the claim documents
Itemized hospital bills with breakup of charges not provided or partially submitted
Diagnostic investigation reports (lab, radiology, pathology) required for claim assessment not submitted
Planned hospitalization proceeding without prior pre-authorization from TPA/insurer as required
Identity documents (Aadhaar, PAN, photo ID) not submitted with the claim application
Treating physician prescription for the claimed treatment or medication not provided
Claim intimation form incomplete, unsigned, or contains discrepancies with hospital records
Accident/medico-legal case requiring FIR/MLC report which was not submitted
Prior medical records demonstrating treatment history for the condition not provided
Specialist referral letter from primary physician not submitted for the claimed consultation
Claim submitted beyond the stipulated time limit (usually 15-30 days post discharge)
Treatment taken at non-network hospital without emergency justification or prior approval
Hospitalization not intimated to insurer/TPA within 24-48 hours as per policy terms
Planned/elective procedure without mandatory pre-authorization approval
Policy premium not paid within the grace period; policy lapsed at time of hospitalization
Same claim already filed and settled under another policy or insurer
Follow-up requirements (e.g., physiotherapy attendance) not complied with
Hospital does not meet the minimum bed/registration criteria under policy definition
Insured person exceeds the maximum entry age or renewal age limit for the policy
Treatment taken outside India or outside the policy's geographical coverage territory
Policy was not in force on the date of hospitalization or treatment
Claimant is not a listed insured member under the active policy
Outpatient consultation and diagnostic expenses not covered under base hospitalization policy
Day care procedure claimed is not in the approved list of day care treatments under the policy
Hospitalization less than 24 hours and procedure not in approved day care list
Treatment location falls outside the geographical coverage area of the policy
Specific coverage limited to certain age bands; claimant outside eligible age range
Optional coverage rider (maternity, dental, OPD) not purchased; claim under base plan ineligible
Home treatment/domiciliary hospitalization not meeting policy criteria for coverage
Policy requires second medical opinion before proceeding; second opinion not obtained
